### MessageDef.deadline

Key: `deadline`

Path: [`message`](#messagesfilemessage).`[]`.`deadline`

Deadline is the countdown duration in minutes. A positive value enables
countdown messages and determines when the countdown reaches zero.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Constraints | `minimum=0` |

### MessageDef.delay

Key: `delay`

Path: [`message`](#messagesfilemessage).`[]`.`delay`

Delay is the wait in minutes before sending an OnConnect message. Zero sends it
immediately after the player connects.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Constraints | `minimum=0` |

### MessageDef.onconnect

Key: `onconnect`

Path: [`message`](#messagesfilemessage).`[]`.`onconnect`

OnConnect set to 1 sends the message once after each player connects; 0 disables
connection-triggered delivery. Delay sets the wait before sending.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Enum | `0`, `1` |

### MessageDef.repeat

Key: `repeat`

Path: [`message`](#messagesfilemessage).`[]`.`repeat`

Repeat is the interval in minutes between message deliveries. A positive value
enables recurring delivery; zero disables it.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Constraints | `minimum=0` |

### MessageDef.shutdown

Key: `shutdown`

Path: [`message`](#messagesfilemessage).`[]`.`shutdown`

Shutdown set to 1 stops the server when the deadline countdown reaches zero. It
has no effect when Deadline is zero or omitted.

| Attribute | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | `integer` |
| Required | no |
| Enum | `0`, `1` |
